sections.text: Critical: 14 days or less, or expired (check_certs_crit_days). Warning: up to 30 days (check_certs_warn_days). Low: up to 60 days (check_certs_notice_days), nothing to do now. 8 more expire within 120 days and are OK: the workbook's Timeline sheet has them. Next after the list: esx11.corp.example.mil, in 63 days. Not listed: 1 trust store certificate (not renewed on the host).
